crossing_cells_with_no_data_claim.mechanism: Rank ≥ 3 in a faction makes its outposts non-hostile; rank ≥ 2 in its rival makes its patrols hostile on sight
A boss who is a faction officer accepts parley at rank; a rival faction's boss gains a two-NPC escort
A hired escort (paid in gold, S15) joins the encounter; a paid caravan route meets a different roster
A boss with a price ends the encounter for gold (RI-EXP06 B-10's third route)
Sneak decides whether the encounter starts at all — a stealth build's roster on the same route is materially smaller
Security opens a boss arena's back door (a different opening position); Alchemy's pre-fight potion changes the fight's phase timings
A utility effect solves a boss: a resist that nullifies its one damage type, a bind that costs it a phase
A book reveals a boss's weakness — BAR-CRITIQUE-01's own worked example. The weakness is inert until the book is read
An undetected player faces no encounter; a witnessed crime spawns guards into the roster
A backstab opener (Souls) and, via SCH, assassinating a boss during a scheduled sleep or rite
A quest outcome adds or removes a boss, or changes its escort or phase set
A boss relocates, or gains/loses an escort, after a world change
A nocturnal roster: different creatures patrol the same ground at night
A boss present or awake only at a time — the window SCH→BOS opens
Salt-storms hide enemies (RI-WLD05 #28): visibility to 15 m, so the roster you can see changes
A boss fought in a storm: reduced player visibility, or a weather-gated ability
The disguise. Wearing a faction's armour changes patrol aggro — the most legible seam crossing in the game
A specific item is a boss's counter: a resist, a tool, a key that opens its arena from behind
An upgrade tier threshold is what makes a specific boss's poise breakable — the cleanest progression W→F cell
Clearing a roster from a region changes faction control of it
Killing the thing that was eating the village raises disposition across the settlement
A roster state satisfies a quest without the quest being "handed in"
A cleared route lets a caravan run again — NPC schedules change
structural. A boss killed or spared reshapes a faction's leadership and its remaining line
Province-wide reaction to the outcome
The boss's death or parley produces the truth about something — an RI-EXP04 N6 revision
structural. The outcome branches the questline for hours
structural. A gate opens, a regional hazard ends, a district repopulates
NPCs move in, or flee
Layout decides encounter composition and whether the player can be flanked
The arena is a system: the ledge, the plunging attack, the pillar (RI-EXP06 B-15)
Patrol schedules are part of the roster: a road is safe at noon and not at midnight
A boss's schedule — asleep, at a rite — is an attack window
